messages.author: 0c881aec7120951b
messages.subject: Re: Unable to deploy dygraphs package in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi guys, I think I found where the problem is.
My app has some Chinese characters in it, and I think in some way that makes deployApps() unable to detect packages I used in this app.
I saved .R files with encoding in UTF-8. And I tried some apps with encoding in UTF-8 without Chinese characters in it.
And it's able to library the packages I need.
So I used helpers.R to library the packages I need, and source it in ui.R and server.R. And it worked! (helpers.R must not contain any Chinese characters)

Again, apology for my poor English. And a BIG thanks to Andy, thanks for your help!

Wish you guys have a nice day :)
